bio.text: James Marter, a software consultant from Oswego, won the Republican primary for Illinois' 14th Congressional District on March 17, 2026.
He is a former Oswego Public Library board member and has run unsuccessfully for Congress four times and for U.S. Senate in 2016.

sources.title: What's next for northern Illinois congressional candidates
14th District GOP candidates say curbing government spending, overreach are top issues
